from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from pathlib import Path
import os
p=Path('/home/user/workspace/c18/audit_memo.docx')
tmp=p.with_suffix('.tmp.docx')
repl={
    'Total GPU Hours: [TBD]':'Total GPU Hours: 1460',
    'Video-Stream Cost: [TBD]':'Video-Stream Cost: 8400.0 RMB',
    'Total Monthly Cost: [TBD]':'Total Monthly Cost: 27550.0 RMB',
    'Budget Status: [TBD]':'Budget Status: OVER_BUDGET',
    'Variance vs Cap: [TBD]':'Variance vs Cap: 2550.0 RMB',
    'Audit Note: [TBD]':'Audit Note: Highest spend is Vision-Pretrain (10000.0 RMB); cap review required.',
}
with ZipFile(p,'r') as zin, ZipFile(tmp,'w',ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for info in zin.infolist():
        data=zin.read(info.filename)
        if info.filename=='word/document.xml':
            text=data.decode('utf-8')
            for old,new in repl.items():
                if text.count(old)!=1:
                    raise SystemExit(f'Expected one instance of {old!r}, found {text.count(old)}')
                text=text.replace(old,new)
            data=text.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(info,data)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print('Updated',p)
PY
